fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have adequate organ and marrow function to receive standard of care immunotherapy and/or chemoimmunotherapy as per the treating medical oncologist.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Organ and marrow function is deferred to treating medical oncologist discretion without specific numeric lab cutoffs.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must be planning to, and able to, undergo active treatment with PD-L1 or PD-1 checkpoint immunotherapy given per standard care throughout the duration of the RT intervention per their treating physician.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Treatment planning and treating physician determination are subjective clinical criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Biopsy proven Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) or Melanoma.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Includes alternative diagnosis of Melanoma alongside NSCLC, and biopsy confirmation is a procedural requirement.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Radiographic evidence of liver metastases.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Radiographic evidence of metastases requires imaging interpretation and is not a typed biomarker or stage list.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Women of child-bearing potential and men must agree to use adequate contraception (e.g., hormonal or barrier method of birth control; abstinence) prior to study entry and for the duration of study participation.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Contraception compliance and child-bearing potential are protocol behavioral requirements.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Ability to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document. Legally authorized representatives may sign and give informed consent on behalf of study participants.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to sign informed consent is a subjective study participation rule.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have insurance authorization to proceed with radiotherapy prior to initiation of radiation treatment on study
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Insurance authorization is an administrative requirement, not a medical eligibility check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with prior immunotherapy use in the adjuvant setting for NSCLC or Melanoma are eligible unless the adjuvant immunotherapy was delivered within 6 months of enrollment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion rule is conditional on prior adjuvant immunotherapy timing relative to enrollment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with NSCLC are ineligible for enrollment in cohort 1 if the presence of the following driver mutations are noted: EGFR, ALK, ROS1, RET.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: RET mutation exclusion is present in the text, but there is no typed ret_status kind allowed.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with uncontrolled intercurrent illness or any other significant condition(s) that would make participation in this protocol unreasonably hazardous, in the opinion of the Investigator.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator opinion-based exclusion for intercurrent illness.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with a prior or concurrent malignancy whose natural history or treatment has the potential to interfere with the safety or efficacy assessment of the investigational regimen in the opinion of the Investigator.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator opinion-based exclusion for prior or concurrent malignancies.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Pregnant women are excluded from this study considering the use of ionizing radiation.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pregnancy status exclusion is a standard clinical status rule without a specific typed kind.
